prompt: During the same year the Orlando Magic lost to the Los Angeles Lakers in their second NBA Finals appearance, what strain of flu spread into pandemic status throughout the world?
answer: It was the **2009 H1N1 influenza strain**, commonly called **swine flu**. The WHO declared it a global pandemic in June 2009, the same year the Orlando Magic lost to the Lakers in the NBA Finals.
